en.answer:
<<5905>> does not target.

At the time of the resolution of <<5905>>, the face-up monster with the highest DEF the opponent controls is destroyed.

In the proposed scenario, during the resolution of <<5905>>, since the face-up monster with the highest DEF the opponent controls has become unaffected by Spell Cards, the end result is that that monster is not destroyed.

(The effect of <<5905>> is not applied, and no other monsters are destroyed instead)
en.question:
The opponent activated <<9352>> in a chain to the activation of your <<5905>>.

During the resolution of <<5905>>, if the monster with the highest DEF the opponent controls has become unaffected by spell Cards, how does this resolve?
en.title: The opponent activated <<9352>> in a chain to the activation of your <<5905>>.  During the resolution of <<5905>>, if the monster with the highest DEF the opponent controls has become unaffected by spell Cards, how does this resolve?

ja.answer:
「<<5905>>」は対象を取る効果ではありません。
「<<5905>>」の効果処理の時点で、相手フィールド上に表側表示で存在する守備力が一番高いモンスター1体を破壊します。

質問の状況の場合、「<<5905>>」の効果が適用される事になる、相手フィールド上に表側表示で存在する守備力が一番高いモンスター1体が、魔法カードの効果を受けない状態になっていますので、結果的にそのモンスターが破壊される事はありません。
（「<<5905>>」の処理は適用されず、他のモンスターが代わりに破壊される事もありません。）
